back_cover_blurb: Describe it. Build it. Ship it.

Vibe coding means building software by describing what you want in plain English and letting an AI write the code. It is how a new generation of creators, students, and professionals is turning ideas into working apps, often in an afternoon.

This book teaches you to do it well, with Claude Code. You will build six real, tested apps, from a tip calculator to a full-stack web app, an AI flashcard tool, and a mobile app for iPhone and Android, and every prompt and reply in those chapters comes from a real session. No programming background required.
- How software works, explained just enough for vibe coders
- Installing Claude Code and having your first conversation
- Prompt patterns that turn vague ideas into working code
- UI and UX design that works for everyone, with accessibility
- Debugging, testing, and saving your work with Git
- Building an AI-powered app with the Claude API
- Building Android and iPhone apps from one codebase
- Putting apps online, and shipping to Google Play and the App Store
- CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, hooks, and MCP
- The software development lifecycle: versions, changelogs, releases
- Security habits that keep your code and keys safe
- Best practices checklist, 40-prompt library, and cheat sheet
